messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy 'pool-orchestra' autoscale policy v1.3 to dedicated-gpu-pool-5 tonight 22:00 UTC. Want someone to own the rollout and smoke checks. Plan: staggered 10% every 5 mins, monitor latency/cost signals, immediate rollback to v1.2 if errors >0.5% or tail latency >200ms.

Dan: I can take ownership. Will run the canary to 10% at 22:00 and sit on pager. I'll post smoke checklist pre-start.

jen: Preflight checklist:
• PR merged? ✅
• Dashboards pinned? ✅
• Canary policy uploaded to infra? ✅
• Alerts scoped to canary? I'll add a short alert for "canary-error-rate > 0.5%".

sam: PR #3421 merged 20:12 UTC. I'll flip the infra flag at T-15 (21:45). @Dan remind me if I'm late :sweat_smile:

kevin: I'll monitor metrics and traces. Manual rollback command tested in staging:
```
infractl policy set --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-5 --policy v1.2
```
Logs to tail: `kubectl logs -l app=autoscaler -n prod --follow`
I'll watch tail latency, queue depth, and GPU utilization.

deploy-bot: pool-orchestra rollout scheduled by maria for 1832509920 (22:00 UTC). Stagger: 10% every 5m. Initiating at scheduled time.

deploy-bot: stage 1 complete — 10% rolled. No anomalies reported.

maria: Good. Dan — after stage 2 (30%) please run the formal smoke: 5 sample generation requests at 1k tokens, verify median latency <120ms and error rate 0.

Dan: Will do. Kicking stage 2 now.

deploy-bot: stage 2 complete — 30% rolled.

Dan: Smoke results: 5/5 samples ok but saw intermittent tail spike to ~260ms on one pod.

kevin: I'm seeing a correlation with cache miss rate up ~12% in the canary group. Traces show KV fetchs from disk for ~120ms.

maria: Pause rollout. Dan, prepare to rollback if cache tweak doesn't land in 10m. Sam, can you push the cache hotfix to canary config?

sam: Pushing hotfix to canary flag now (`cache.prefetch=1.1`). Will post PR and infra toggle in ~3m.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by automation due to alert: canary-tail-latency > 200ms at 1832509260.

Dan: Received. Investigating. If cache prefetch change doesn't reduce tail in 10m, I'll trigger `infractl policy set --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-5 --policy v1.2` and mark rollback reason "tail-latency-regression".

sam: Hotfix applied and infra flag toggled at 1832509295.

kevin: Metrics update: tail latency back to ~110ms after hotfix, cache miss rate dropped to 3% in canary.

deploy-bot: Rollout resumed — continuing from 30%.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete — 100% rolled to v1.3 at 1832509340. No open alerts in last 5m.

maria: Thanks everyone — nice catch and quick fix. Dan/kevin, please keep a two-hour watch. I'll update the release note and close the PR.

Dan: Will monitor. If anything flares I'll roll back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
